parameters.query: SELECT CASE WHEN $2 = 'accepted' THEN nexus.accept_intake_item(NULLIF($1,'')::uuid,$3) WHEN $2 IN ('needs_more_evidence','rejected') THEN nexus.record_intake_review(NULLIF($1,'')::uuid,NULLIF($2,'')::nexus.intake_review_state,$3) ELSE NULL::uuid END AS review_result_id, CASE WHEN $2 = '' THEN 'view_only' ELSE $2 END AS submitted_action, session_user AS reviewer_login;

SELECT intake_item_id, ticker, source_title, source_published_at, review_state, review_basis, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, admitted_review_evidence_id, limitations FROM nexus.v_automation_intake_queue WHERE ($1 = '' OR intake_item_id = NULLIF($1,'')::uuid) ORDER BY retrieved_at DESC;
